meta.note: Deterministic sections are reproducible for a given corpus, provider and OCR engine; 'timing' is machine-dependent.

cost.note: Projected from token counts at the configured per-1M-token prices (OPENAI_INPUT_PRICE_PER_1M / OPENAI_OUTPUT_PRICE_PER_1M); a rule-based provider actually costs nothing. Token counts are character-based estimates unless the provider reports usage.
